result.instructions: Tools for currencylayer, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "What is the latest USD to EUR exchange rate?"; "Show the USD to GBP rate on 2026-10-01."; "Convert 100 USD to EUR using my enabled currencylayer plan.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes currencylayer data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run currencylayer_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run currencylayer_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run currencylayer_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. currencylayer_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: currencylayer_get_live_rates
tools.title: Get live exchange rates
tools.description: SPENDS 1 request of your currencylayer monthly quota per call (also when it fails after authentication; it is never retried). Real-time exchange rates for up to 174 world currencies and precious metals relative to a source currency (default USD). Quotes are keyed by pair, e.g. USDEUR = 0.918 means 1 USD = 0.918 EUR. The free plan refreshes daily, higher plans hourly down to every 60 seconds. Use 'currencies' to limit the reply. GET /live.

currencies.description: Only these currency codes, e.g. ["EUR","GBP","JPY"] (default: all of them).

source.description: Source (base) currency code, default USD. Needs the Basic plan or higher; every quote is then SOURCE+TARGET, e.g. EURGBP.

tools.name: currencylayer_get_historical_rates
tools.title: Get historical exchange rates
tools.description: SPENDS 1 request of your currencylayer monthly quota per call (also when it fails after authentication; it is never retried). Exchange rates for one past date (data back to 1999 for most currencies; a currency added later has no data before its start date and the whole request then fails). Quotes are keyed by pair, e.g. USDEUR. Use 'currencies' to limit the reply. GET /historical.

date.description: The date to look up, yyyy-mm-dd.

currencies.description: Only these currency codes, e.g. ["EUR","GBP","JPY"] (default: all of them).

source.description: Source (base) currency code, default USD. Needs the Basic plan or higher; every quote is then SOURCE+TARGET, e.g. EURGBP.

tools.name: currencylayer_convert_currency
tools.title: Convert an amount
tools.description: SPENDS 1 request of your currencylayer monthly quota per call (also when it fails after authentication; it is never retried). Convert an amount from one currency to another with real-time rates, or with the rates of a past date. Returns the result and the quote used. Needs the Basic plan or higher. GET /convert.

from.description: Currency to convert from, e.g. USD.

to.description: Currency to convert to, e.g. EUR.

date.description: Use the rates of this date (yyyy-mm-dd) instead of real-time rates.

tools.name: currencylayer_get_timeframe_rates
tools.title: Get exchange rates for a date range
tools.description: SPENDS 1 request of your currencylayer monthly quota per call (also when it fails after authentication; it is never retried). Daily exchange rates for every date from start_date to end_date (at most 365 days apart), one entry per date. Needs the Enterprise plan or higher. The reply must stay small: days x currencies may not exceed 2000 (without 'currencies' that is 174 per day), checked before the request is sent. GET /timeframe.

end_date.description: Last date, yyyy-mm-dd (not before start_date, at most 365 days after it).

currencies.description: Only these currency codes, e.g. ["EUR","GBP","JPY"] (default: all of them).

source.description: Source (base) currency code, default USD. Needs the Basic plan or higher; every quote is then SOURCE+TARGET, e.g. EURGBP.

annotations.title: Get exchange rates for a date range

tools.name: currencylayer_get_rate_changes
tools.title: Get exchange rate changes
tools.description: SPENDS 1 request of your currencylayer monthly quota per call (also when it fails after authentication; it is never retried). How exchange rates changed between two dates: per currency pair the start_rate, end_rate, absolute change and change_pct. Pass both dates or none (none = yesterday's end-of-day rate against the latest rate). Forex markets are closed on weekends, so a weekend change can be zero. Needs the Enterprise+ plan or higher. GET /change.

start_date.description: Start date, yyyy-mm-dd (give both dates or neither).

end_date.description: End date, yyyy-mm-dd (give both dates or neither).

currencies.description: Only these currency codes, e.g. ["EUR","GBP","JPY"] (default: all of them).

source.description: Source (base) currency code, default USD. Needs the Basic plan or higher; every quote is then SOURCE+TARGET, e.g. EURGBP.
